newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends at 13.76 rgt/kg on new 27-month low.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends at 13.76 rgt/kg on new 27-month low.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 32 cents to 13.76 ringgit ($5.88) a kg on Tuesday, marking a new 27-month low, traders said.
They said sellers crowded the market after a sharp overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME).

"The LME went down sharply, so the local market had to follow," said a trader in Malaysia. "There were only buyers at the lower levels." Offers overwhelmed bids by 114 tonnes to nine. Final turnover was 94 tonnes, against 125 on Monday. The premium against London widened to $55 from $45.
